messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: ELB target group tg-3f2b unhealthy count spike in eu-west-1c - 22 unhealthy targets - increased 00:03 minutes. Monitoring: target-health-check-timeout > 95th pct.
oncall-alana: acked. I'm on it, paging SRE. Paging rota.
sre-lina: on-call here — pulling recent healthcheck logs and route53 resolver checks.
eng-runtime-joel: seeing repeated TCP RSTs from instances in az1c. Might be IMDS throttling or kernel Conntrack exhaustion.
oncall-alana: quick triage: 
- ELB healthcheck timeout -> 500/504s for upstream
- Route53 latency to eu-west-1c nameservers elevated
- No large deploys reported in last 15m
sre-lina: running describe-target-health, output snippet:
```
{"TargetHealthDescriptions":[{"Target":{"Id":"i-0a1b2c3d4e","Port":443},"HealthCheckPort":"443","TargetHealth":{"State":"unhealthy","Reason":"Health checks failed"}}]}
```
eng-runtime-joel: grabbing syslogs from one impacted host, truncated:
```
Mar 17 10:02:12 ip-10-0-2-45 kernel: conntrack: table full, dropping packet.
Mar 17 10:02:14 imdsv2: request throttled, 429 returned
Mar 17 10:02:18 nginx: upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header
```
network-ops-ryan: route53 check - some az1c resolvers showing 50-200ms higher latency, likely transient but aligns with health probe windows.
eng-runtime-joel: mitigation plan I will execute now (short-lived steps):
1) Drain unhealthy targets from tg-3f2b to stop noisy probes: `aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:... --targets Id=i-...`
2) Increase healthcheck timeout to 10s and healthy threshold to 3 for tg-3f2b to avoid flapping while we stabilize.
3) Scale up ASG by +3 instances in eu-west-1b to take traffic off eu-west-1c.
4) Apply conntrack tuning on a sample host and push as ASG launch config update if it helps.
oncall-alana: please post PR/ops commands as you run them. Keep me in loop for customer comms.
eng-runtime-joel: running deregister command now.
eng-runtime-joel: deregister completed for 9 badly unhealthy targets :white_check_mark: 
sre-lina: bumping healthcheck timeout to 10s on tg-3f2b. Command:`aws elbv2 modify-target-group --target-group-arn arn:... --health-check-timeout-seconds 10 --healthy-threshold-count 3`
product-raj: assessing customer impact. Which tenants behind this TG? Top customers: auto-billing, chatbot-proxy, docs-search (low qps but high SLO).
cs-amelia: CS: we've had ~7 user reports for slow responses the past 10m, mostly EU customers. I'll prepare a short status page note.
network-ops-ryan: pushed temporary Route53 failover for weighted traffic away from eu-west-1c to eu-west-1b (weight shift 80/20) — verify.
eng-runtime-joel: scaled ASG +3 in eu-west-1b and patched conntrack settings on new launch template (net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144) — rolling new instances.
sre-lina: after changes, target unhealthy count decreased from 22 -> 6 in 4m. Latency to healthcheck endpoints back to baseline.
oncall-alana: good. Prep incident bridge for handoff in 20m. Who will take second shift?
sre-lina: I'll stay for handoff for 30m then hand to network-ops-ryan.
eng-runtime-joel: collecting post-mortem artifacts: ELB metrics, instance syslogs, conntrack counters, Route53 resolver traces.
product-raj: drafted status page update: 
"We are currently investigating elevated error rates and latency for customers in eu-west-1. Impact started ~10:02 UTC; mitigation in progress. Some requests may be routed to eu-west-1b. We will update within 30 minutes."
cs-amelia: sent notification to affected customers and set triage tags for billing/chatbot teams.
sre-lina: follow-up check: `cat /proc/net/nf_conntrack_count` shows descending counts after conntrack tuning and new hosts.
network-ops-ryan: Route53 weighted shift held, no adverse global impact. Monitoring for DNS propagation stable.
oncall-alana: new status: degraded -> partial service restored for eu-west region. Continuing monitoring for 45m.
sre-lina: capturing all runbook steps in the incident doc. Will open postmortem ticket and include remediation: ASG launch template baseline change, increase conntrack defaults, and healthcheck thresholding recommendations.
eng-runtime-joel: note: long-term: investigate IMDS rate limiting pattern on our bootstrap/agent and add jitter/backoff.
network-ops-ryan: taking over oncall handoff in 30m.
cs-amelia: closing loop with customers who reported issues, offering post-incident summary.
oncall-alana: thanks team — handing off to @network-ops-ryan. :wave:
network-ops-ryan: acked. I'll monitor overnight and update the incident thread if anything reoccurs. :eyes:
incident-bot: Incident auto-note: updated severity to SEV2 -> length 00:56 since initial alert.
